notes.title: 《HSHS! Turn me on》: really will someone like Yu Qi? He is so cold!
notes.notes:
"HSHS! Turn me on!" has gained significant popularity online, frequently mentioned by netizens. Initially, I thought it was just another sappy romance micro-drama, but upon further investigation, I discovered that it was actually a game? The live-action drama incorporates interactive elements, allowing viewers to watch the show and play a dating game simultaneously.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027385/41c33d8653253eaed85397d70a5fb19e5b483591.jpg[/img]
This piqued my interest, and I promptly purchased the game on Steam. I couldn't help myself and ended up playing it for the entire day. There are five male leads in the game, some of whom I'm interested in, and some who I'm not too fond of. The male lead named Yu Qi, however, left the deepest impression on me, mainly because he's so infuriating!
Yu Qi is a 26-year-old CEO of Yupin Inc., a fashion brand group, and an ingenious business elite. He's handsome, wealthy, but unfortunately, he has a big mouth. Players need to control the female protagonist to approach Yu Qi and obtain the live streaming agency rights for his company. Upon their first meeting, he verbally abuses her, which is not all, I sent him a sailboat model that he liked, but he not only didn't appreciate it, he smashed it to bits!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027385/45fd83c8e95acba30a5f07b68385ee1aa9bb7f53.png[/img]
At this point, I was so angry that I quit the game and searched for other people's reviews online. They were mostly similar to mine, everyone was complaining about Yu Qi's bad temper. However, there were also some people who were interested in Yu Qi, saying that he was just a softie at heart. I really couldn't understand, how could anyone like Yu Qi who always had a cold face and yelled at people?
But as I continued playing, I started to understand the people who liked Yu Qi. First of all, he didn't intentionally smash the sailboat model, but did so accidentally. After I manipulate the heroine to leave in a huff, Yu Qi didn't leave, instead, he silently bent down and picked up the pieces one by one. I never expected such an act from someone who was so arrogant before.
Yu Qi is a proud, sarcastic person who initially firmly refused the protagonist's request, but later relented and said that as long as he could invite another male lead, Song Shi, a popular idol, to live stream, he would authorize the agency rights. As the game progressed, Yu Qi's proud and sarcastic personality was thoroughly demonstrated. Even when he was jealous, he still insisted on being tough, but in reality, he had already fallen for the heroine.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027385/a4fd20e1738199bd41cefa4593dad1d2d90d6c63.png[/img]
Upon learning about Yu Qi's background, it becomes clear that his previous cold and hard attitude was just a shell he used to protect himself. He didn't easily achieve his current status; his past is truly heart-wrenching.
So in the end, I managed to complete the confession scene with Yu Qi, which I would have never believed at the beginning. However, the contrast made me unable to dislike him, and I even found him a bit cute. This was a big slap in the face for me.
"HSHS! Turn me on!" has a total of five male leads. Now I'm going to start a second playthrough to conquer the next guy!

notes.title: 嘶哈6.2日准备发布啦！《HSHS! Turn me on》plans to launch on Jun 2nd!
notes.notes:
“Hissha! This Man is a Little Handsome" is the first Chinese female-oriented virtual interactive romance game. You will maneuver Nicco Tang, a first-time live broadcast operation assistant, to meet five charming and differently styled male leads in your busy daily life, towards a destined ending that is uniquely yours! Look at how ordinary she is, yet she manages to control the love of five male leads. The top innocent flower manipulates the love of five male leads to the limit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027385/81f7fcecf68ed70e4a267de5210659b4c4c5cb88.png[/img]
Zhou Shengyan - a restrained and stoic Chinese-style president
Qi Yu - the arrogant and venomous spokesperson of the group
Song Shi - "two-faced" top love beans
Ji Jingze - "white moonlight" gentle senior
Lu Zhiyao - "little wolf dog" rebellious biker 

[Real-life Interpretation, Extremely Immersive]
This is the first female-oriented virtual interactive game in China. Unique real-life shooting techniques, rich interactive plot design, countless shots in the drop together are immersive, breaking the boundary between virtual and real, immersive experience of every sweet moment.
[Multiple plots, free choice]
Multiple plot lines intertwined with the world of adventure, each of your choices will lead to a different adventure, the key to destiny, in your own hands.
He grew up with you and treated you like a sister, but he has feelings for you that are not like a brother's.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027385/f351b80711e72deb1c31432b702c38845c9ef407.png[/img]
He is a top idol, seemingly distant, but you have given him a rare bit of warmth.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027385/4527d2a8bab954bd26f7f02e6b15c9930b5048b6.png[/img]
He is your childhood neighbor, a motorcycle club rider, full of passion and fire.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027385/e44d0a08f34f191398453f94017814d55e8b9c79.png[/img]
He was your college white moonlight, but suddenly he intruded into your life.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027385/2bbfe1faaec5f2d99edb7e17a6aac91abc17b2ae.png[/img]
He is a powerful and ruthless CEO, but you have given him a different feeling.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027385/1991392f4f1184dc78d43dfb763def6245361a8f.png[/img]
[Emotional Engagement, Social Interaction]
Provide you with a platform to communicate and interact with other players, and experience the true emotions of each moment.
